annotations.title: Change the closing date, the questions and steps, or what people may send.

description: Changes the settings the organiser can change on the site: the day collecting stops, the questions people are asked, whether they may send voice, video or writing, which one the button offers first, and whether the people recording are offered to chip in towards the printed book. Nobody is told about a change.

answer_with.description: Any of voice, video and written.

chip_in.description: true offers everyone who records the chance to put money towards the printed book, which comes off what the organiser pays; false stops offering it.

closes_on.description: The day collecting stops, as a date. It means stop collecting rather than finished.

lead_with.description: Which one the big button offers first.

questions.description: The questions people are asked, up to twelve.

steps.description: The whole list of steps, in order, as start_book takes them. It replaces the steps the book had. An empty list goes back to plain questions. A person who already answered keeps their page.

name: change_the_book
